rounds.head: 540354d6
rounds.note: The two gemini lanes split on SEVERITY, not fact: both found the same substring-match and src-only defects in vocab_gate.rs and disagreed only on whether they blocked. The claude lane found two further blockers neither gemini lane reached.
blockers: B1: the correction landed in binding B5 and never reached Amendment A2, the document that literally carried the retracted `sigma_entity: pv-contract`. On main A2 and the vocab files agreed; at that head they disagreed with no errata — the branch was WORSE than main on the axis it claims to improve. Also unaddressed: §3.4 forbids editing a vocabulary in place.
B2: three live assertions of the retracted value, each sitting directly above its own correction (the B5 bullet and both vocab headers).

B3: the gate did not do what its doc comment claimed. `classify` asked whether the concatenated text of src/ contained the substring `fn <cited>`. apex's theorem-bind.sh, whose design this cites, resolves with grep -qxF against a curated ledger and FAILS on an empty value. The port turned exact-match-against-a-registry into substring-match-against-raw-text and apex's (empty) refusal into a silent filter.

resolution: B1: Erratum A2.1 added to the spec, stating the retraction, preserving A2's second half (a term is not an instance of a Σ class), and putting the §3.4 in-place-edit exemption argument to the operator rather than assuming it.
B2: all three assertions now say retracted.

B3: the resolver parses DECLARATION POSITIONS only, requires a #[test] fn, scans tests/ as well as src/, returns empty values instead of filtering them, and panics on an unreadable contract. All six demonstrated attacks were GREEN before and are RED now; both honest paths still pass.
attacks_closed: test_rhl_vocab_0 — a strict prefix of a real test
test_function — a name existing only inside a string literal
is_palindrome — a name existing only inside a doc comment
main — a real fn, but not a #[test]
discharged_by: with no value — silently skipped, never examined
discharged_by : with a space before the colon — silently skipped
diff_sha256_note: Recomputed with pmat-merge's own canonical spelling on a clean tree. The previous artifact's hash resolved to nothing under any spelling — computed against a working tree carrying an uncommitted .pmat/baseline.json. No false PASS followed, because agreed was false, but a hash that resolves to nothing in a re-arm record is the same shape as a discharged_by that resolves to nothing, which is what this PR is about. Found by the claude lane.
residuals: `sigma_entity` is read by no test; nothing would catch a re-guess tomorrow.
RHL-1's real block (spec open question O1) is prose-only; a machine-readable `blocked:O1` label would keep it checkable.
B5 attributes ONT-001 §3.7 to apex's 'header'; it is in metadata.references, and apex cites v4.3 where B5 says v4.9.
